name: softube-ts-kick-click
description: Add kick click/attack with the Softube Transient Shaper — the manual's HIGH-band FAST-punch kick recipe (crossover 700 Hz) so only the beater click above 700 Hz is sharpened, not the low end. Clip is OFF here (in a normalize-after render the 0 dB soft-clip eats the very transient the punch adds — measured; flip it ON only for in-DAW loudness/density). For a kick stem or kick-forward bus that needs more beater click.
intended_for: a kick stem or drum bus that needs more high-frequency click/attack
plugin_build: Softube 'Transient Shaper.vst3' (renders headless via Pedalboard; iLok-authorized — re-verify on a new machine)
notes: Manual recipe is Punch + / HIGH / FAST / xover 700 (manual uses Clip ON; we default OFF — measured: with the normalize-after render the clip soft-clipped the boosted peaks back down, netting crest -0.8). FAST catches the sharp HF click. MEASUREMENT NUANCE: on a deep, LF-dominated kick the peak is the body thump, so aggregate crest barely moves even though the 4-8k click band rises — judge the click by the HF band / by ear, not bus crest. Don't over-boost an already-clicky kick (unnatural pop); QC with detect-mix-issues.
